unit.title: Pattern and Symmetry
unit.blurb: Lines of symmetry in 2D shapes and letters, completing symmetrical shapes, and repeating and symmetrical patterns.
unit.subject: maths

O1.t: Identify 2D shapes and lines of symmetry, and complete symmetrical shapes.

O2.t: Recognise, continue and make repeating and symmetrical patterns.

p: A **line of symmetry** splits a shape into two halves that match like a mirror. Fold along it and the halves fit exactly.
A square has 4 lines of symmetry; a rectangle has 2.
Folding a rectangle along its diagonal does not make the halves match.
